<b>Flapping Fertids</b> are [[Enemies (Silksong)|enemies]] in <i>[[Hollow Knight: Silksong]]</i>. They are docile bugs with bulbous bodies and wings that mimic the grasses of the [[Far Fields]].<ref> Flapping Fertid [[Hunter's Journal (Silksong)|Hunter's Journal]] entry: <i>"Docile bug whose wings mimic the grasses of the Far Fields. ... In flight, its bulbous body quickly ruins the ruse."</i></ref>

== Behaviour and Tactics ==
Flies back and forth idly, pausing briefly to make a small noise before continuing flying.<br>
Deals {{Damage|1}} on contact despite its non-aggression.

=== Act 3 ===
[[Black-Threading|Black-threaded]] Flapping Fertids have their health doubled. They can gain any of the standard [[Black-Threading#Movesets|void attacks]].

== [[Needolin]] Dialogue ==
{{SS Needolin|columns=2|
* From heat we grow...
* Between bone we sprout...
* Shells soft...
* Leaves hide...
}}

== Location ==
Flapping Fertids are found primarily in the [[Far Fields]], though one also appears in the eastern [[Deep Docks]].
